transcript.en: I'm very pleased to welcome this evening's guest speaker, Mark Logan, who's going to tell us about the recent transformation of Minster Park. Over to you, Mark.
transcript.zh: 很高兴迎来今晚的特约发言人，马克·罗根。他将为我们介绍敏斯特公园最近的变化。交给你了,马克。

transcript.en: Thank you. I'm sure you're all familiar with Minster Park.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。我相信大家已经对敏斯特公园十分熟悉了。

transcript.en: It's been a feature of the city for well over a century, and has been the responsibility of the city council for most of that time. What perhaps isn't so well known is the origin of the park: unlike many public parks that started in private ownership,
transcript.zh: 这个城市的特色已经有一个多世纪了，大部分时间由市议会负责。也许不太为人所知的是这个公园的起源：与许多私人拥有的公园不同，

transcript.en: as the garden of a large house, for instance, Minster was some waste land, which people living nearby started planting with flowers in 1892.
transcript.zh: 比如，敏斯特原本作为一座大宅的花园，曾是一片荒地，1892年附近居民开始在上面种花。

transcript.en: It was unclear who actually owned the land, and this wasn't settled until 20 years later, when the council took possession of it.
transcript.zh: 人们并不确定土地的主人是谁，直到20年后,市政局接管了它,这一问题才得到解决。

transcript.en: You may have noticed the statue near one of the entrances. It's of Diane Gosforth, who played a key role in the history of the park.
transcript.zh: 马克:你们也许已经注意到了一个入口旁的雕塑。那是黛安·戈斯福思。她在这座公园的历史中扮演了重要的角色。

transcript.en: Once the council had become the legal owner, it planned to sell the land for housing.
transcript.zh: 市政局刚一成为这里的合法主人,就想要将它以房屋用地卖掉。

transcript.en: Many local people wanted it to remain a place that everyone could go to, to enjoy the fresh air and natural environment - remember the park is in a densely populated residential area. Diane Gosforth was one of those people.
transcript.zh: 许多当地居民希望将它保留为公共区域,所有人都可以到这里享受新鲜的空气和美好环境—别忘了,这个公园位于人口密集宅区。黛安·戈斯福思就是当时的居民之一

transcript.en: And she organised petitions and demonstrations, which eventually made the council change its mind about the future of the land.
transcript.zh: 她组织了请愿和示威游行,最终迫使议会改变了对这片土地的未来规划的决策。

transcript.en: Soon after this the First World War broke out, in 1914, and most of the park was dug up and planted with vegetables, which were sold locally. At one stage the army considered taking it over for troop exercises and got as far as contacting the city council, then decided the park was too small to be of use.
transcript.zh: 不久之后,第一次世界大战在1914年爆发了,公园的大部分都被翻整,种上了用于在当地售卖的蔬菜。在某一时期,军队曾考虑过接管这个地方用于军事训练。相关事宜已经进行到与市政厅商议的环节,但是却因为这个公园面积太小而放弃了。

transcript.en: There were occasional public meetings during the war, in an area that had been retained as grass.
transcript.zh: 战争期间,在被保留作为草坪的区域,偶尔举行公众集会。

transcript.en: After the war, the park was turned back more or less to how it had been before 1914, and continued almost unchanged until recently.
transcript.zh: 战争结束后,公园大体上回归到1914年之前的样子,直至今日几乎没有改变。

transcript.en: Plans for transforming it were drawn up at various times, most recently in 2013, though they were revised in 2015, before any work had started. The changes finally got going in 2016, and were finished on schedule last year.
transcript.zh: 改造公园的计划经常被提起,最近一次是在2013年,但是在工程开始之前的2015又修订了计划。整个修整项目在2016年得以实施,按照计划于去年完工。

transcript.en: OK, let me tell you about some of the changes that have been made - and somethings that have been retained. If you look at this map, you'll see the familiar outline of the park, with the river forming the northern boundary, and a gate in each of the other three walls.
transcript.zh: 好的,我来给你们介绍一下已经完成的改造计划,还有保留下来的部分。如果看这张地图,就会发现和公园相似的轮廓,公园北面的便是一条河,其它三面的围墙上各有一扇门。

transcript.en: The statue of Diane Gos forth has been moved: it used to be close to the south gate, but it's now immediately to the north of the lily pond. almost in the centre of the park. which makes it much more visible.
transcript.zh: 黛安·戈斯福思的雕塑曾被放置在不同地方:过去它紧邻南门,但是现在它就在荷塘的北面,几乎就在公园的中心,这样看起来更加显眼。

transcript.en: There's a new area of wooden sculptures, which are on the river bank, where the path from the east gate makes a sharp bend.
transcript.zh: 公园新开辟一个区域,放置了一些木质雕塑,就在河畔上,从东门延展过来的小路在这里有个急转弯。

transcript.en: There are two areas that are particularly intended for children. The playground has been enlarged and improved, and that's between the river and the path that leads from the pond to the river.
transcript.zh: 有两个区域是专门为孩子们准备的。我们扩大了游乐场的面积并且完善了设施。游乐场就在河流和那条连接河流与池塘的小路中间。

transcript.en: Then there's a new maze, a circular series of paths, separated by low hedges. That's near the west gate - you go north from there towards the river and then turn left to reach it.
transcript.zh: 另外,公园里还有一个新的迷宫,低矮的篱笆把迷宫中的层层环状小路分开。迷宫靠近西门。从西门出发,向北边河流方向前进,然后左转就到了。

transcript.en: There have been tennis courts in the park for many years, and they've been doubled, from four to eight. They 're still in the southwest corner of the park, where there's a right-angle bend in the path.
transcript.zh: 公园中的网球场已经存在很多年了,目前网球场的数量由四个变成了八个,增加了一倍。网球场还是在公园的西南角,小路在那里拐了个直角弯。

transcript.en: Something else I'd like to mention is the new fitness area. This is right next to the lily pond on the same side as the west gate.
transcript.zh: 我还想要介绍的是新的健身区域。它和西门在同一侧,紧挨着荷塘。

transcript.en: Now, as you're all gardeners, I'm sure you'll like to hear about the plants that have been chosen for the park.
transcript.zh: 现在,因为大家都是园艺工作者,我想你们定想要听一下被选来种在公园中的植物。
